text_en: To the leader. Of David. A Psalm.
I waited patiently for the Lord ; he inclined to me and heard my cry.
text_cn: 我热切诚恳地期待了上主， 他便垂顾俯听了我的哀诉。

text_en: He drew me up from the desolate pit, out of the miry bog, and set my feet upon a rock, making my steps secure.
text_cn: 他把我从祸坑与污泥中救出， 放我在磐石上，稳定我的脚步。

text_en: He put a new song in my mouth, a song of praise to our God. Many will see and fear, and put their trust in the Lord .
text_cn: 他将新歌置于我口，为赞美我们的天主； 众人见了起敬起畏，都将全心信赖上主。

text_en: Happy are those who make the Lord their trust, who do not turn to the proud, to those who go astray after false gods.
text_cn: 凡全心依靠上主，不对傲慢倾慕， 且又不依附虚伪的，这人真有福！

text_en: You have multiplied, O Lord my God, your wondrous deeds and your thoughts toward us; none can compare with you. Were I to proclaim and tell of them, they would be more than can be counted.
text_cn: 上主，我的天主！你行的奇迹异事，真令人不知几许！ 你对我们的计划，无人能与你相辅， 我纵愿宣扬申述，也多得不可胜数。

text_en: Sacrifice and offering you do not desire, but you have given me an open ear. Burnt offering and sin offering you have not required.
text_cn: 牺牲与素祭已非你所喜，就开了我的耳朵； 全燔之祭以及赎罪之祭，也已非你所要。

text_en: Then I said, “Here I am; in the scroll of the book it is written of me.
text_cn: 于是我说：“你看，我已到来！ 关于我，书卷上已有记载：

text_en: I delight to do your will, O my God; your law is within my heart. ”
text_cn: 我的天主，承行你的旨意为我所喜爱， 你的法律常存于我的心怀。”

text_en: I have told the glad news of deliverance in the great congregation; see, I have not restrained my lips, as you know, O Lord .
text_cn: 在盛大的集会中，我宣扬了你的正义， 看，我并没有闭口不言，上主，你全知悉。

text_en: I have not hidden your saving help within my heart, I have spoken of your faithfulness and your salvation; I have not concealed your steadfast love and your faithfulness from the great congregation.
text_cn: 我从没有将你的正义隐蔽在心间， 对你的忠厚和救援时时各处宣传； 对于你的慈爱和忠义， 在盛会中我没有隐蔽，

text_en: Do not, O Lord , withhold your mercy from me; let your steadfast love and your faithfulness keep me safe forever.
text_cn: 上主，求你对我不要撤回你的怜悯， 愿你的慈爱和忠诚对我时加保存。

text_en: For evils have encompassed me without number; my iniquities have overtaken me, until I cannot see; they are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart fails me.
text_cn: 因为，四周困迫我的灾祸，实在不可胜数； 我的罪过紧握着我，使我无法目睹； 数目比我头发还多，真使我心痛苦。

text_en: Be pleased, O Lord , to deliver me; O Lord , make haste to help me.
text_cn: 上主，求你开恩救我， 上主，求你速来助我。

text_en: Let all those be put to shame and confusion who seek to snatch away my life; let those be turned back and brought to dishonor who desire my hurt.
text_cn: 愿那些谋图杀害我的人，一同蒙耻受辱， 愿那些喜欢我遭难的人，一起含羞退走！

text_en: Let those be appalled because of their shame who say to me, “Aha, Aha! ”
text_cn: 愿那些哈哈戏笑我的人， 都满面羞惭地惊惶失神！

text_en: But may all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you; may those who love your salvation say continually, “Great is the Lord ! ”
text_cn: 愿那些寻求你的人，都因你欢欣鼓舞， 愿恋慕你救恩的人，都常说：“大哉上主！”

text_en: As for me, I am poor and needy, but the Lord takes thought for me. You are my help and my deliverer; do not delay, O my God.
text_cn: 我虽然卑微贫苦， 我主却对我眷顾； 你是我的助佑，我的救援， 我的天主，求你不要迟延。
